title: How to use RNExchange (Broker Admin)
subtitle: A guide to managing traders and accounts in the RNExchange simulator
introduction: Welcome to RNExchange Broker Admin! This is a simulated trading environment designed for educational purposes. All account balances, journal entries, and positions are simulated — this is NOT real money.

responsibilities.title: Your Responsibilities as a Broker Admin
items: Post funds journal entries (credits and debits) for trader accounts
Monitor trader balances and buying power
Review risk alerts and account status
Access trader statements and settlement reports

items.name: Broker Dashboard
items.description: Overview of active traders, total cash, and exposure across your broker

items.name: Clients
items.description: List of all traders, their balances, and current P&L. Click Details to manage individual accounts

items.name: Funds Journal
items.description: Create credit or debit journal entries to adjust trader account balances

items.name: View Journal Entries
items.description: Search, filter, and view all journal entries with pagination. Filter by type, search by description, and view detailed entry information

items.name: Settlements
items.description: View settlement batches and access trader statements after end-of-day processing

items.title: View Trader List
items.description: Go to Clients to see all traders under your broker, their balances, and status

items.title: Credit Funds to a Trader
items.description: Navigate to Funds Journal, select a trader, choose Credit, enter amount and reason, then submit

items.title: Debit Funds from a Trader
items.description: In Funds Journal, select a trader, choose Debit, enter amount and reason. Note: Negative balances are allowed but will be flagged

items.title: View Journal Entries
items.description: Navigate to View Journal Entries to search, filter, and view all journal entries with pagination

items.title: Monitor Account Status
items.description: Check the Clients list or individual trader details to see if accounts are negative or at-risk

items.title: Review Trader Statements
items.description: After end-of-day processing, access trader statements to verify balances and P&L reconciliation

demoUsers.title: Demo Users
demoUsers.description: For testing and demos, use the broker_demo account. This account has access to demo traders and can be reset between demo sessions.

disclaimer: Remember: RNExchange is a simulated environment. All account management and journal entries are for educational purposes only. This is NOT real money or real trading.
